Evidence Status and Reading Guide
This version is a self-contained research archive. It contains the raw 60-row
questionnaire le and the reconstructed 52-row analysis matrix, the raw ride/PO
narratives, the original 160-segment FGD transcript, the 27.7-minute self-report au-
dio and its 185-segment GPU transcript, the four qualitative corpora, the stimulus
metadata, the nal Python pipeline, the R reproduction scripts, the seeds, the gener-
ated JSON/CSV outputs, and the thesis gures. The historical two-arm simulation
is reported as an inherited model summary; the nal calibrated in-silico experi-
ment (v8.0) is reproduced by the included pipeline and is reported separately. The
distinction between measured eld evidence, model-based counterfactual evidence,
and theoretical propositions is maintained throughout. Appendix K gives the exact
commands, and Appendix L identies the package contents.
The questionnaire concerns audience evaluations in a convenience sample.
Historical simulation contrasts concern a specied model. The prospective agent
experiment concerns computational task performance.
These three units of evi-
dence cannot be substituted for one another. The original focus-group transcript is
integrated in Appendix G and Section 6.7; the audiovisual recordings and partici-
pant roster remain unavailable. The supplemental seven-part generated analysis is
available for critical review but is not a substitute for those records (Appendix G.4).
The FGD supplies provisional design hypotheses, not additional questionnaire re-
sponses. The researcher self-report is included as reexive context; independently
